boundary.description: From the bridge over the Lostock – Blackrod railway, E along the railway to Lostock station and S along Rumworth Road and by a beeline to M61 Motorway near junction 5 (excluding Winslow Road estate), E along the Motorway then S along Westhoughton Civil Parish boundary, to Bolton – Wigan District boundary and along that boundary and Westhoughton Civil Parish boundary crossing Manchester Road (A6) and by a bee-line across the fields to the bridge over Lostock – Blackrod railway.
